attestation.note: Verified directly against the arXiv HTML rendering of Proposition 5 and footnote 29 on 2026-09-14; the stable source handle is supplied in lieu of an extended transcription.

proposed_statement_changes.reason: In the empty-intersection fallback, \(\mathcal H_n\) contains every nonempty compact subset of the policy cube. Arbitrary compact sets need not be finite unions of polytopes, so the frozen representation clause is false on that branch. The narrowed claim preserves the exact symbolic fallback and both exact radii, and limits the finite-union representation clause to the nonempty branch where every member is generated by finitely many allocation polytopes.

The displayed variance equals the random-arm conditional-multinomial variance only when \(\pi_1=1/2\); for general positive \(\pi_1\) it is \((1/8-t_0^2)/\pi_1\). Clipping also makes \(S_{\widehat t}\) well typed on every sample while being asymptotically inactive at an interior \(t_0\).

proposed_core_edits.reason: The arm-conditional observable cells \(q_z(d,k)\) and the independence cancellation used in the proof require positive instrument-arm probabilities, so the already-frozen positivity assumption must be a declared dependency.

proposed.justification: The lemma separates testable observed-law implications of monotone selection from the maintained latent model.
proposed.gap: The principal-stratum inequalities are standard, but recording them as derived compatibility restrictions prevents the observed law from being assumed compatible by fiat.
proposed.consumer: Every path-feasibility and confidence-region computation can reject incompatible observed laws before solving allocation systems.

proposed.gap: The published benchmark does not supply the finite-alphabet joint set or its path decomposition when complier support is incomplete.
proposed.consumer: Applied users recover the familiar Marx intervals whenever the empirical support condition is credible.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The narrowed claim separates the polyhedral nonempty branch from the symbolic all-compact-sets fallback while retaining the original dependencies and declared computational outputs.

proposed.justification: The theorem turns the nonconvex path representation into a terminating exact procedure for both reported confidence objects and their metric informativeness.
proposed.gap: Finite categorical instrumental-variable programs handle one convex compatibility region; they do not compute Hausdorff radii for a common-parameter collection of law-dependent nonconvex path unions.
proposed.consumer: Oregon Medicaid analysts can compute exact outer regions and diagnose their Hausdorff width before reporting extrapolations at support boundaries.

proposed.gap: Generic nonsmooth-bound asymptotics do not state this explicit rank-policy folded-normal loss law.
